sn12.38:1.2: “Intend” (_ceteti_) and “plan” (_pakappeti_) play the role of “choices” (_saṅkhāra_), while “underlying tendencies” (_anuseti_) stand for “ignorance”.
sn12.38:1.3: That is, it takes rebirth in a new life.
sn12.38:1.4: It “grows” as the individual grows up and matures, leading to renewal of the cycle.
